description: Tokens on Arc that publish machine-readable receipts per the fetchable spec. Verifiers use this to find a token's fetch.json from its contract address. Listing here is not an endorsement; the receipts prove themselves or they don't.
how_to_list: Publish a fetch.json for your token per SPEC.md (served with open CORS), then open a pull request adding your contract address and the document URL below. PRs that point at documents which fail verification will not be merged.
